name: io.github.chrischall/skylight-mcp
description: Skylight Calendar for Claude — family events, chores, and rewards.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An OAuth refresh token you already hold. Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Skylight account email. Pair with SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD for direct login. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Skylight account password — required iff SKYLIGHT_EMAIL is set. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_FRAME_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional: pick a specific Skylight frame when the account has more than one.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.skylight-mcp/tokens.json.
